Introduced in %1$s
Private Favourites
A separate space for collections you want to keep more private.

Private Favourites stays a separate workspace while isolation is enabled. If security or isolation is removed, you can keep the Private collection or move it back, and unisolated Private content can participate normally across the app.
Favourites → Private
Manage Private from Favourites. When disabling its security, choose whether to keep the Private collection or move it back to Normal Favourites.
Gekkoushi Plugin Support
More sources through the Tsuki plugin ecosystem.
Miyorare can now install and run the Gekkoushi plugin, including source browsing, search, details, chapters, and Reader access through the Tsuki runtime.
Settings → Sources → Tsuki Plugins
Install Gekkoushi from plugin settings, enable it, then choose the sources you want to use.
Reader WebView
Open the current chapter on the web without breaking your reading flow.
Reader now offers an optional WebView control for opening the current chapter page when you need to sign in, pass a challenge, or inspect the source page.
Reader → Actions → WebView
Enable the WebView control, then use the WebView button in Reader when a chapter needs it.
Library Groups
Build a more personal collection, not just another category.
Group selected manga, use a local cover, arrange an Advanced Timeline, and organize the collection around the way you read.
Favourites → Library Groups
Create a group, choose its cover and category, then arrange its reading timeline.
Group Tracking Search
Find the right tracker match for a Library Group in one sheet.
Group tracking search now shows visual results with cover art, titles, alternative titles, a best-match marker, and in-place re-search.
Library Group → Group Details → Tracking
Open tracking for a Group, choose the best result, or refine the query in the same sheet.
New Favourites Themes
Sakura, Violet, Cyan, Emerald, Amber — choose your atmosphere.
Normal Favourites now has theme choices with stronger visual identities and dedicated header artwork.
Favourites → Appearance / Theme
Open the Favourites appearance settings and select the theme you want.
Independent Private Themes
Normal and Private do not have to look the same.
Private themes can be selected independently from Normal, with their own palette, preview, and artwork.
Private Favourites → Private Theme
Choose a Private theme without changing the theme used by Normal Favourites.
Miyorare Modern
A more modern, personal, and consistent Miyorare experience.
Miyorare’s interface continues to be refined across Favourites, Explore, Settings, and other surfaces for a cleaner and more consistent identity.
Favourites, Explore, Downloads, Settings, and more
Select Miyorare Modern from Appearance settings to use the modern visual system.
More Improvements
🔒 Private isolation now follows your security choice while keeping Private collection membership intact.
🔧 Navigation, gestures, sorting, selection state, and stability were improved across the app.

🎉 **Miyorare 1.0.0 — A New Chapter**

Miyorare has levelled up. Collections are tidier, the interface is prettier, and secret stuff… stays secret. 👀

## ✨ Private Favourites
A dedicated home now exists for collections that should not hang out in Normal Favourites. Isolation can now follow your security choice: when removing security, you can keep the Private collection or move it back to Normal.

## ✨ Gekkoushi Plugin Support
Miyorare can now install and run Gekkoushi through the Tsuki runtime, bringing its source catalogue into browsing, search, details, chapters, and Reader flows.

## ✨ Reader WebView
Reader now has an optional WebView action for opening the current chapter page when a source needs a login, browser challenge, or a quick look at the original page.

## 📚 Library Groups
Some manga deserve more than alphabetical order. Create groups, choose a local cover, arrange an Advanced Timeline, and build the reading order you actually want. 😌

## 🔧 Group Tracking Search
Tracker matching for Library Groups now uses a visual search sheet with covers, alternate titles, best-match guidance, and in-place re-search.

## 🗂️ Download Structure Info
Folder structure explanations are now available as info sheets, making it easier to understand where Manga, Novel, and Local content is stored without changing the download layout itself.

## 🎨 Favourites Got More Personality
Miyorare, Sakura, Violet, Cyan, Emerald, and Amber now have dedicated header identities. No more pretending that moving the hue slider counts as a whole new outfit. 🌸💜💎

## 🕶️ Private Has Its Own Style Too
Normal can wear Sakura while Private goes Violet. They are grown up now; matching clothes are optional.

## ✨ Miyorare Modern
More of the app now follows Miyorare’s modern, cleaner, more consistent visual language. Classic is still around for anyone saying, “the old one was already comfy.”

## 🔒 Privacy Hardening
Private context is guarded according to the active isolation setting. When isolation is disabled intentionally, Private membership is preserved while History, search, tracking, suggestions, backups, and related features follow that choice consistently.

## 🔧 Calmer and More Stable
Navigation, gestures, sorting, selection state, and other rough edges were polished. Some bugs left politely. Others required an escort.

## 🖼️ Final Favourites Artwork
Normal and Private Favourites now use their final dedicated header artwork so every theme has an identity of its own.

## 🐞 Bug Fixes
- Improved Gekkoushi/Tsuki source compatibility by aligning plugin request headers with Usagi behavior.
- Fixed selected-state and recreation problems in several flows.
- Reduced navigation and gesture conflicts.
- Improved Private and Favourites stability.
- Added assorted performance and reliability fixes behind the scenes.

> **Thanks for using Miyorare.**
> 1.0.0 is not the finish line. It is simply the point where Miyorare can finally say:
> **“Okay, now I’ve got my own app.”** ✨
